title: The RSVP
logline: The reply card. A pen. The dog's chin on his foot. He checks 'will attend' and the strip gives the checkmark a whole panel.

panels.composition: The table, lowered a little already — no, not yet; the table at full height. The reply card, cream, two boxes. WOOD with a pen. BARNABY's chin on his foot.

image.prompt: a man at a drafting table holding a pen over a small cream reply card with two checkboxes, an old dog's chin resting on his foot, razor-sharp ink

panels.composition: The card: ☐ will attend · ☐ regrets. The pen's tip above the first box.

image.prompt: close-up of a cream reply card with two empty checkboxes and a pen tip hovering above the first

panels.composition: The checkmark. One stroke. The whole panel.

image.prompt: close-up of a single confident ink checkmark in a small box on cream card, filling the panel
image.notes: The checkmark is the panel. One stroke, brush.

panels.composition: The card in its envelope. The stamp. Wood looking at the dog.

balloons.text: Don't look at me like that. I said will attend. I didn't say I'd enjoy it.

image.prompt: a man sealing a small envelope and speaking to an old dog who is looking at him

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The checkmark gets a panel. 'I didn't say I'd enjoy it.'
